name: restart-manager
author: Takaro
description: Scheduled server restarts that warn players and wait for a safe moment. Set restart times as cron expressions (default 04:00 UTC every day). Players get countdown warnings (default 30, 15, 5 and 1 minutes before). Before the shutdown the module can save the world and kick everyone, with a save and shutdown command per game (7 Days to Die saveworld, Rust server.save, Minecraft save-all); by default Takaro's own shutdown is used. Safe window: a restart waits while it would hurt players and tries again every few minutes, up to a max delay. Built-in checks: 7 Days to Die blood moon (game time and BloodMoonDay), at least N players online, a recent PvP kill, and your own console checks (run a command, wait while the output matches a pattern). Admins use restartnow <minutes> and restartcancel; everyone can type restartstatus. Optional Discord announcements.
summary: Scheduled restarts with countdown warnings (30/15/5/1 min), optional save and kick-all, per-game save/shutdown commands (Takaro shutdown by default) and a safe window: wait during a 7 Days to Die blood moon, while N players are online, after a PvP kill or while a console check matches, up to a max delay. Admin restartnow/restartcancel, player restartstatus.

schedules.title: Restart times (cron)
schedules.description: When the server restarts, in the time zone below. Cron format: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. '0 4 * * *' = every day 04:00, '0 */6 * * *' = every 6 hours, '0 6 * * mon' = Monday 06:00. Empty = only restarts by command.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone for the restart times, e.g. 'Europe/Berlin' or 'America/New_York'. Unknown names fall back to UTC.

warningMinutes.title: Warnings (minutes before)
warningMinutes.description: Broadcast a warning this many minutes before each restart. The biggest number is when the countdown starts.

saveBeforeShutdown.title: Save the world first
saveBeforeShutdown.description: Run this game's save command (see Game commands) right before the shutdown.

kickAllBeforeShutdown.title: Kick everyone first
kickAllBeforeShutdown.description: Kick all online players (with the kick message) right before the shutdown.

gameCommands.title: Game commands
gameCommands.description: Console commands per game. An empty shutdown command uses Takaro's own shutdown (recommended). An empty save command skips saving.

maxDelayMinutes.title: Max delay (minutes)
maxDelayMinutes.description: How long a restart may wait for a safe moment, counted from its planned time. After that it restarts anyway. 0 = never wait (all safe-window checks off).

checkEveryMinutes.title: Check again every (minutes)
checkEveryMinutes.description: While a restart is on hold, check this often whether it is safe now.

resumeCountdownMinutes.title: Countdown after a hold (minutes)
resumeCountdownMinutes.description: When a restart on hold may go ahead, players get this many minutes of warning first.

minMinutesBetweenRestarts.title: Min minutes between restarts
minMinutesBetweenRestarts.description: Skip a scheduled restart that comes this soon after the last one (for example after a late or manual restart).

bloodMoonDelay.title: Wait for the blood moon (7 Days to Die)
bloodMoonDelay.description: On 7 Days to Die servers, do not restart during the horde night window. Uses the console commands gettime and ggs BloodMoonDay. Ignored on other games.

bloodMoonStartHour.title: Blood moon window starts (game hour)
bloodMoonStartHour.description: In-game hour on the blood moon day from which restarts wait. The horde starts at 22.

bloodMoonEndHour.title: Blood moon window ends (game hour)
bloodMoonEndHour.description: In-game hour on the morning after from which restarts may run again. The horde ends at 4.

bloodMoonFrequency.title: Blood moon every (days, fallback)
bloodMoonFrequency.description: Only used when the server does not report BloodMoonDay: a blood moon every this many days.

delayWhenPlayersOnline.title: Wait while this many players are online
delayWhenPlayersOnline.description: Hold the restart while at least this many players are online. 0 = off.

pvpQuietMinutes.title: Wait after a PvP kill (minutes)
pvpQuietMinutes.description: Hold the restart until no player killed another player for this many minutes. Needs a game that reports the attacker on player deaths. 0 = off.

consoleConditions.title: Console checks
consoleConditions.description: Your own safe-window checks: the restart waits while the output of the command matches the pattern (a regular expression, case-insensitive). Example: command 'gettime', pattern 'Day (7|14|21|28),' with reason 'blood moon day'.

warningMessage.title: Warning message
warningMessage.default: Server restart in {time}. Find a safe spot and log out in time.

postponedMessage.title: On hold message
postponedMessage.default: The server restart is on hold: {reason}. It runs when it is safe.
postponedMessage.description: Sent when a restart waits for a safe moment. Placeholders: {reason} {time} (max wait left) {prefix}

forcedMessage.title: Forced message
forcedMessage.default: The server restart can not wait any longer ({reason}). Restart in {time}.
forcedMessage.description: Sent when the max delay is reached. Placeholders: {reason} {time} {prefix}

restartingMessage.title: Restarting message
restartingMessage.default: The server is restarting now. See you in a few minutes!
restartingMessage.description: Sent right before the save and shutdown. Placeholders: {prefix}

cancelMessage.title: Cancel message
cancelMessage.default: The planned server restart was cancelled.
cancelMessage.description: Sent when an admin cancels a restart players were already warned about. Placeholders: {prefix}

kickMessage.title: Kick reason
kickMessage.default: Server restart. Please reconnect in a few minutes.
kickMessage.description: Shown to kicked players when 'Kick everyone first' is on.

pvpReason.title: Reason text: PvP
pvpReason.default: a PvP fight in the last {minutes} minutes

discordChannelId.title: Discord channel ID
discordChannelId.description: Also post the first warning, holds, cancels and the restart itself to this Discord channel. Empty = off. Takaro's Discord bot must be in your server.

permissions.description: Restart the server with restartnow and cancel or skip restarts with restartcancel.

restartstatus.description: Shows when the next server restart is, or why it is on hold.
restartstatus.helpText: restartstatus = time until the next server restart.

restartnow.description: Admin: restart the server in N minutes with warnings (0 = right away).
restartnow.helpText: restartnow [minutes] = restart with a countdown (default 5). restartnow 0 restarts right away. Skips the safe-window checks.

restartcancel.description: Admin: cancel the restart that is counting down, or skip the next scheduled one.
restartcancel.helpText: restartcancel = stop the current countdown or hold. With nothing counting down it skips the next scheduled restart.

on-player-death.description: Remembers the last PvP kill for the 'Wait after a PvP kill' check.

tick.description: Every minute: start the countdown for scheduled restarts, send warnings, check the safe window and restart.
